static_traits.name: Chen Haoran
static_traits.family_status: Living with partner, with two Chihuahuas
static_traits.social_status: Has friends and family to confide in, but has not yet communicated with anyone about this; relationship with girlfriend affected by unease
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no history of similar psychological problems or treatment
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly strong logic, high cooperativeness, able to self-Reflect, calm tone

basic_info.main_problem: I have been feeling Anxiety and insecurity about my shell-collecting hobby, because I think my girlfriend finds it strange. Starting to feel nervous after noticing my girlfriend's expression a few months ago, especially when I interpret her expression as disapproval, stress rising; currently developed to feeling uneasy when talking about the hobby, daring not to share with her or others.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize Anxiety and insecurity are affecting my intimate relationship and causing pain, so seeking psychological counseling to alleviate distress, improve the relationship.

core_beliefs: Being different from others equals being negated

special_situations.event: When showing the shell collection to girlfriend, noticing her confused or uninterested expression
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other shows confusion or disinterest, it means she negates me and my hobby
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing the collection with girlfriend, hiding the hobby to reduce the risk of being negated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She thinks I am strange, she does not approve of me

special_situations.event: When the topic of 'interests and hobbies' comes up in daily conversation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I mention collecting shells, others will all think I am weird and look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding sharing interests in Social situations, Displacing the topic
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will think I am very weird, better not to say it

special_situations.event: Recalling the single confused/uninterested expression girlfriend once showed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative cues are more credible than positive evidence; once disapproval appears, it means being negated overall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive evidence in relationships, focusing only on negative cues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She probably does not like this side of me overall

special_situations.event: Considering whether to communicate directly with girlfriend about the hobby and feelings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If this is brought into the open, she will deny me on the spot, look down on me, the relationship will worsen
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids starting conversations to protect relationships and self-esteem, continuing to stay silent
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Saying it will make things worse, better not to talk about it

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized by the partner as she is, able to share real interests freely
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated for 'being different', being looked down upon, then being distanced or abandoned
defense_goal: Reduces the possibility of being judged and humiliated through hiding and avoidance
Suppressing shame and Anxiety through Rationalization, maintaining superficial harmony of self-esteem and the relationship

object_relations.self_representation: A fragile self, easily judged, that needs to hide real interests
object_relations.object_representation: picky, an important other who may negate or humiliate oneself (such as girlfriend)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests communicating directly with girlfriend or invites expressing more genuine feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Unconsciously Anticipating the other will negate oneself like important others do (transference: projecting inner negation expectations onto the current relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Focusing on analysis and Interpretation, emphasizing reasons like 'now is not convenient/not the right time', tone calm but avoiding directly expressing Anxiety and shame.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing the other (especially girlfriend) show a confused or uninterested expression
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing one's own unease and shame to the other 'thinking I am weird' (transference/Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use expressions guessing others' thoughts (such as 'she surely thinks I am weird'), reducing disclosure of one's own feelings, avoiding further verification.

manifestations: Fearing being negated after exposing real interests, choosing to hide oneself
Interpreting others' expressions as negation, feeling distant from people
Unwilling to discuss real worries with partner or others, avoiding direct contact

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Inferring from girlfriend's expression that the other 'thinks I am strange', not yet directly verified
In conversation, replaces expression of one's own experience with others' possible evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual has maladaptive self-Reflection and excessive self-limitation, being overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly concerned with others' evaluations, worrying about being looked down on and avoiding sharing interests
Being cautious when talking about the hobby, tending to Repress real preferences

positive_force: Shares multiple positive interests with the partner (yoga, outdoor activities), and the relationship has a positive foundation
Has a social support network of friends and family
Proactively seeks help, positive attitude; willing to try cognitive restructuring and self-affirmation
Able to describe automatic thoughts and emotional experiences, with a certain degree of self-awareness
negative_force: Highly sensitive to others' evaluations, overly dependent on external validation
Cognitive biases such as mind reading, overgeneralization, and mental filtering are prominent
Avoiding direct communication to reduce Anxiety in the short term, forming maintaining factors
Sleep and appetite disturbed, reducing emotional resilience and focus

target_behavior.behavior: Obvious Anxiety appearing when hobby topics come up, avoiding sharing the shell-collecting interest with others (especially partner)
antecedent: Seeing her confused or uninterested expression when showing the collection to girlfriend
When the topic of 'interests / hobbies' comes up in conversation
When teaching at Work, thinking partner may not approve of the hobby
target_behavior.core_reason: Interpreting the other's expression as negation, labeling oneself as 'very weird', accompanied by mind reading and catastrophic reasoning, triggering intense Fear of Being rejected and shame
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the possibility of being evaluated or Being rejected, reducing shame and Anxiety in the short term to maintain self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced self-disclosure and sharing, leading to Strained intimate relationships; Sleep disturbance, Decreased appetite; attention affected when teaching
